company.name: unitQ
company.shortDescription: UnitQ is an AI enabled platform that monitors and transforms product quality with real-time customer feedback insights.
company.description: UnitQ is an AI-enabled product quality monitoring platform that empowers companies to take a data-driven approach to product quality so they can fix the right quality issues faster. The company's customer feedback platform empowers users to identify quality issues simultaneously with their customers, pinpoint the impact of product launches, releases, or ongoing features generating the most bugs or support tickets, and delve deep into issue origins across various sources, platforms, devices, customer segments, and beyond.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered quality intelligence platform that aggregates customer feedback and operational data, classifies issues, connects them to business KPIs, and supports real-time product and customer experience analysis.
productsAndServices.name: unitQ Platform

productsAndServices.description: An autonomous AI assistant for querying customer feedback and engagement data, generating cited insights, visualizations, recommendations, and root-cause analysis.
productsAndServices.name: agentQ

productsAndServices.description: A competitive intelligence product that analyzes public competitor feedback to benchmark product quality, identify customer friction, and track market trends by region, feature, and experience.
productsAndServices.name: competeQ

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered support quality assurance product that evaluates human agent and bot interactions, identifies coaching opportunities, and flags compliance or service risks.
productsAndServices.name: supportQ
